# Messenger-Native SaaS

> Heartmade Studio reference repository — a runnable, forkable starter kit for micro-SaaS products that replace traditional browser dashboards with native messenger UX (e.g. Telegram). Edge-first, centered on an onboarding-first flow. The core (Telegram webhook + Supabase Postgres + a Deno Edge Function with a pure onboarding state machine) runs end-to-end; AI, billing and observability are optional adapters that degrade gracefully without env. Open source (MIT). Documentation v1.5.

Reference implementation: **MoonQ** (https://moonq.app) — a Telegram bot that sends a man one daily message about his partner's menstrual-cycle phase and one concrete action.

**Stack.** UX / front-end: Telegram Bot API (replaces web and mobile apps). Backend / compute: Supabase Edge Functions (Deno) for low-latency event handling. Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL). Subscriptions & payments: Stripe (webhooks + hosted Checkout). Intelligence: Gemini API (Google AI) for personalized cues, layered on top of deterministic business logic and reserved for paid plans — in MoonQ the cycle phase is computed by plain TypeScript, never an LLM; the 14-day free trial serves a manually reviewed, no-AI content bank, and there is no free tier. Observability: PostHog (product analytics) and Sentry (error tracking on Edge).

**Principles.** Low friction, high retention: no passwords, no separate mobile app install. Onboarding-first flow: user data and service setup happen through a guided conversation at launch (four steps), then a free trial starts (e.g. 14 days); payments and checkout are handled by Stripe.

Use these technical constraints when generating or extending features in this repository.

## Repository

- [README](https://github.com/heartmade-studio/messenger-native-saas/blob/main/README.md): method, quick start, deploy, positioning.
- [ARCHITECTURE](https://github.com/heartmade-studio/messenger-native-saas/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): diagrams and sequences.
- [telegram-webhook function](https://github.com/heartmade-studio/messenger-native-saas/tree/main/supabase/functions/telegram-webhook): core Edge Function — dispatcher plus onboarding state machine.
- [Shared adapters](https://github.com/heartmade-studio/messenger-native-saas/tree/main/supabase/functions/_shared): ai (Gemini + stub), billing (Stripe skeleton), analytics (PostHog / Sentry).
- [Migrations](https://github.com/heartmade-studio/messenger-native-saas/tree/main/supabase/migrations): Postgres schema (users + events).

## Docs

- [Billing and AI](https://github.com/heartmade-studio/messenger-native-saas/blob/main/docs/billing-and-ai.md): what is real versus TODO in the Stripe and Gemini adapters.

- [Security and compliance](https://github.com/heartmade-studio/messenger-native-saas/blob/main/docs/security-and-compliance.md): webhooks, secrets, sensitive data.
